name: Calgary Waldorf School

geo.address: 515 Cougar Ridge Drive SW, Calgary, AB T3H 5G9
geo.coord_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim geocode of the official address (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), 2026-10-30 — street-level match (Cougar Ridge Drive SW), not the building

description: Independent Waldorf school founded in 1985 in southwest Calgary; Parent & Tot, preschool and kindergarten through Grade 9. States that it fulfils both the Waldorf curriculum and the Alberta Education curriculum.

attributes.philosophy: Steiner/anthroposophical developmental stages inform pedagogy; arts, imagination and movement integrated into all subjects; head, heart and hands.

legal_status.label: Independent (private) school registered under the Education Act (Alberta); listed by Alberta Education as authority type 'Private School'

attributes.grades: Parent & Tot, Junior Kindergarten (3–4), Kindergarten, Grades 1–9
attributes.curriculum: Waldorf curriculum plus Alberta programs of study (school statement).

tuition.notes: First child: Kindergarten full day $13,760; Grades 1–6 $12,050; Grades 7–9 $13,790. Sibling rates 90% / 40% / 15%. Field trip & supply fee $470–$940 by grade. JK $15,150 (5 full days) before Alberta affordability grants.

attributes.additional_fees: Field trip & school supply fee $470–$940; after-care $1,850–$3,900/yr; $500 acceptance deposit and staged non-refundable deposits.
attributes.admission: Application; Grade 1 entry age 6 by 1 September; Grades 2–9 reviewed individually; JK on a wait-pool list for 2026/27.

campuses.name: Cougar Ridge campus
campuses.address: 515 Cougar Ridge Drive SW, Calgary, AB T3H 5G9

advantages: Established (1985) full Waldorf grade school to Grade 9
limitations: Funded/non-funded accreditation category not confirmed from an official source
attributes.qualifying_reason: Private school confirmed in Alberta Education's school and authority directory (extract 2026-10-28); Waldorf programme to Grade 9 and 2026/27 tuition read on the official site.

sources.title: School and Authority Information Report (authority_and_school.xlsx, extract date 2026-10-28)

verification.notes: Official site and Alberta directory read. Accreditation sub-category (registered / accredited non-funded / accredited funded) not stated in the directory.

limitations: Alberta's directory does not show funding category; the school's statement that it teaches the Alberta curriculum is consistent with, but does not prove, accredited-funded status.
